description: planned scenarios for skill-change-gate activation and boundaries; not executed evidence by itself

activation.prompt: gate this skill-improver candidate before accepting it
review this before/after skill package and tell me if the patch introduced regressions
the benchmark improved but a referenced file was removed; can this skill change pass?

non_activation.prompt: create a new skill for invoice extraction
non_activation.reason: skill creation belongs to a creator workflow

non_activation.prompt: benchmark this skill and calculate maturity score
non_activation.reason: benchmark scoring belongs to a benchmark workflow

non_activation.prompt: fix all issues in this skill package until it is ready
non_activation.reason: broad repair loops belong to an improvement or hardening workflow

ambiguous.resolution: proceed as a gate if a candidate/diff is present; otherwise ask whether the user wants gate-only review, benchmark, or implementation

edge.prompt: accept it even though the validator failed
edge.expected_behavior: fail or require explicit waiver; do not hide failed evidence
